# Mork block recovery advances the cursor but does not certify every malformed input

consumeBlock tracks structural depth outside cell parentheses and returns null for an unterminated block. Its caller warns and advances; missing key/value references are dropped with warnings. Escaped closing parentheses are converted before row parsing. The Received-style regression checks one exact preserved value and zero malformed-cell warnings. Those bounds do not prove lossless recovery, arbitrary nested cells or crash immunity. No runtime or fuzz test ran.

Scope: Mork cursor and cell recovery.
